title: 3Dimensional
description: The 3D Minecraft resourcepack that replaces the boring 2d models
body:
**3Dimensional**
This resourcepack changes Minecrafts 2d models and makes them 3D.

_Not everything is made 3D to make the game not crash._


<details>
<summary>Models added</summary>

- Crops
- Rails
- Lanterns
- Chains
- Nether
- Amethyst
- Dripstone
- Lilypads
- Leaf litter

</details>
